title: Short-term rental (Airbnb) of an owned apartment — Culebra (island municipio), coastal zone
description: I rent out an apartment I own in Culebra as a short-term rental on Airbnb. It is already furnished; no construction.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
Short-term rental: Ley 272-2003 as amended by Ley 52-2022 requires Compania de Turismo registration of STR hosts. (KB: RULE_0033, RULE_0148, RULE_0261)
Guests overnight: room-occupancy tax (Ley 272-2003). (KB: RULE_0601, RULE_0602, RULE_0691)

mustNotInclude.rationale: No construction in the description: RULE_0643-0646 need project_type new_construction/renovation, structural_work or construction_approvals_required.
Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
In the coastal zone but no construction-type work: RULE_0708 any_of requires construction / exterior / site work.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
No employees: CFSE policy rules need Q_EMPLOYEES_HIRED=true.
